findings.summary: A marker written by a manual cli-hierarchy clear <planner> is only removed by runRestarts for names in state.rotateAsked; status keeps showing a stale rotate request with a growing age.

findings.summary: If requestRotate fails, nextAsked[name] is still set to 0, so the request is not retried and the grace window starts anyway.
findings.title: pipeline-cli/src/hierarchy/dispatch-loop.ts: if requestrotate fails, nextasked[name] is still set to 0, so the request is not retried and the grace window starts anyway.
